description: Orbit CLI binary and host that sent the event. Attached to every Orbit CLI event.

cli_version.description: Version of the Orbit CLI binary, such as `0.42.0`.

os.description: Operating system the CLI binary was built for, such as `macos`, `linux`, or `windows`.

arch.description: CPU architecture the CLI binary was built for, such as `aarch64` or `x86_64`.
